name: Chiyuri no Kakushitsu
source:
Chiyuri was a famous magician, her beauty known throughout the lands...
But having turned down proposals from too many men, she has made herself enemies in high places.
One such man seeks vengeance for being turned down.
He abducts Chiyuri and thus begins her harrowing ordeal!
